sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Ultra-HD 4K Minimally Invasive Rigid Endoscopes

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Company Register administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — bifurcated Anglo-French legal heritage; English Common Law governs company, commercial and financial-regulation law; French Civil Law retains residual private-law influence; customary law applies to land and traditional matters.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Marrakesh Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (Vanuatu accession effective 24 August 2012)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus) — in force for Vanuatu 13 December 2020
Melanesian Spearhead Group Free Trade Agreement (MSG/FTA) — Vanuatu contracting party
EU–Pacific States Economic Partnership Agreement (interim EPA) — trade-preference regime applicable to Vanuatu as an ACP State (ratification status to be verified)
Bilateral Investment Treaty with the People's Republic of China (concluded 2006) — claimed benefits to be verified through the UNCTAD IIA Navigator

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 33 of 1992, as amended including beneficial-ownership amendments); Companies Act [Cap. 191]; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2018 (as amended); Financial Services Commission Act No. 23 of 2017; VFSC Beneficial Ownership Registration Guidance Notes and AML/CFT Rulebooks; supervised alignment with the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) Mutual Evaluation Report of Vanuatu (2018) and subsequent enhanced follow-up reporting.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (each beneficial owner, director and shareholder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or Commissioner for Oaths in the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention) or Consular Legalization for non-party jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the last three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or account-holding financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille, or Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and financial standing certificate (account relationship older than 6 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Settlement bank or correspondent bank maintaining the applicant's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization, or bank-to-bank authenticated telex/SWIFT verification for Swift_LC and TT_Wire onboarding

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate UBO piercing pack — certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register of directors and shareholders, and certificate of incumbency of the ultimate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or licensed registered agent of the jurisdiction of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the parent jurisdiction is a party to the 1961 Convention; otherwise Consular Legalization via the Vanuatu diplomatic mission having consular competence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of Wealth / Source of Funds declaration (sworn)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Beneficial owner executing the declaration before a notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization where apostille is unavailable)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD screening of every beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK/EU consolidated financial sanctions, and the domestic Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit watchlist, supplemented by adverse-media review; PEP status requires senior-management approval, documented source of wealth, and enhanced transaction monitoring for at least 12 months after cessation of public office; screening must be evidenced and retained by the VFSC-licensed registered agent for a minimum of 5 years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry — Online Name Search and Reservation Module; reservation applications are lodged through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent, with public search access available via the VFSC online registry index.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be rendered in Latin script using English or French. Non-Latin scripts (including Chinese characters) require a Latin-script transliteration approved by the registered agent and stated in the Memorandum and Articles. The name must end in a liability indicator such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', or the French equivalent 'Société Anonyme'/'SA'. The VFSC disallows registration of names that are identical or confusingly similar on a phonetic or visual basis to an existing registered entity, reserved name, or protected trade mark.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Procedure: (1) the licensed Registered Agent files the name reservation and a refusal notice is issued with stated statutory grounds; (2) within 14 calendar days of refusal, the agent files a written reconsideration request with the VFSC Registrar annexing evidence of distinctiveness, such as an additional distinctive word element, goodwill evidence, or a written consent letter from the prior holder; (3) the Registrar issues a written decision within 21 business days; (4) a further appeal lies to the VFSC Regulatory Appeals Panel under the Financial Services Commission Act No. 23 of 2017 within 30 calendar days of the adverse decision; (5) if the 30-day reservation lapses, the same name may be re-filed immediately with a modified distinctive element or after the lapse period where no intervening third-party reservation was accepted, subject to the re-payment of the applicable reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permitted under the restricted registered-agent model: the statutory registered office must be a physical street address in Vanuatu maintained by a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; no local employees, premises, or Vanuatu operations are required. A pure virtual arrangement without licensed-agent coverage or reliant on a P.O. Box is not permissible. For the ISIC 3250 endoscopy-tower manufacturing scope, the IC may operate as a tax-exempt conduit holding global hardware manufacturing, procurement, and distribution rights outside Vanuatu, with an economic-substance declaration confirming that no Vanuatu-relevant activity is carried on.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low baseline risk of approximately 10% for a standard-risk ISIC 3250 manufacturing IC with no local operations; VFSC supervisory inspections are documentary audits performed through the registered agent. Probability elevates to 60–70% only upon PEP or adverse-media triggers, sanctions-list hits, suspicious-transaction reporting, or an APG/FATF-directed supervisory sweep.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 8 of 1993 (Cap 222), as amended: s. 6 (incorporation), s. 7 (application for incorporation), s. 8 (certificate of incorporation), s. 9 (memorandum), s. 10 (articles), s. 54 (directors), s. 57 (registered office and registered agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form IC-02) together with executed Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up or authorised capital is prescribed under Cap 222; the Memorandum may authorise 1,000 ordinary shares at VUV 100 par value. No escrow account or capital deposit obligation is imposed by the VFSC for an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The subscription list of shares is approved; 1,000 ordinary shares at VUV 100 par value are allotted to the founding subscriber fully paid in cash. 2. The registered office of the Company is fixed at Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the VFSC-licensed registered agent is approved, per section 57. 3. The following officers are appointed: Director, Company Secretary, and Resident Agent; each to serve until the next annual meeting. 4. The Directors are authorised to execute all statutory filings, industrial licensing, and bank account documentation incidental to the manufacture of ultra-HD 4K rigid endoscopes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Clearance and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry via VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name reservation request proposing up to three permissible names for the International Company, together with an executed letter of engagement for a VFSC-licensed registered agent. The agent verifies name availability against the VFSC index, distinguishes the proposed name from existing registered names, and confirms absence of prohibited or offensive terms.
required_dossiers: VFSC Name Reservation Request Form IC-NR-01
Letter of Engagement appointing licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected for similarity or impropriety, the agent submits an alternative name from the reserved list within 2 business days; no additional government fee is levied for resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Vanuatu / Registered Agent's Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding subscriber executes the Memorandum and Articles of Association under ss. 9-10 of the International Companies Act Cap 222, with an objects clause expressly authorising the manufacture, assembly, distribution, and sale of medical devices, including ultra-HD 4K minimally invasive rigid endoscopes, and the free alienability of shares.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association executed by subscriber
Articles of Association executed by subscriber
Certified photographic identity documents of subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defects in execution are cured by re-execution with notarial attestation; registry queries on the objects clause are answered through an affidavit of the subscriber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Application for Incorporation with the VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the statutory Application for Incorporation under s. 7 Cap 222 with the executed M&A, director and secretary consents, and prescribed particulars of registered office and agent. The application is filed through the VFSC electronic case management portal or in paper at the Registry counter.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director (Form IC-03)
Consent to Act as Secretary (Form IC-04)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query letter, the registered agent files a supplementary clarification memorandum or amended appendix; amendments are made by rider signed by the subscriber without repayment of the state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Fee Payment and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the prescribed incorporation fee of USD 250 by SWIFT wire or card to the VFSC consolidated revenue account; the Registrar then issues the Certificate of Incorporation under s. 8 Cap 222 under the official seal, effective on the date of issuance.
required_dossiers: SWIFT wire or card payment receipt
Incorporation cover letter with IC reference number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure of payment reconciliation is cured by furnishing a bank SWIFT MT103 statement; a lost certificate is replaced by a duplicate upon submission of a statutory declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting: Share Subscription, Registered Office and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Board of Directors; minutes maintained by Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (or pass a written resolution) to approve the allotment of 1,000 ordinary shares, adopt the registered office at Port Vila, and appoint the founding directors and company secretary. The pro-forma first board resolution is passed and entered into the statutory minute book.
required_dossiers: Minutes of First Board Meeting / Written Resolution
Register of Members and Share Allotment Ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If quorum cannot be achieved in person, the meeting is held by telephone conference; alternatively all directors execute a written unanimous resolution with equal effect under the Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Books, Seal and Share Certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the certificate of incorporation is issued, the agent prepares the common seal, share certificates for the allotted shares, and opens the statutory registers, including register of members, register of directors, register of charges, and beneficial ownership intimation where applicable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Discrepancies in share certificates are rectified by cancellation and re-issuance at no cost upon return of the original certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Department of Strategic Management, Ministry of Trade, Tourism and Commerce
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Registration Certificate (FIRC) and Business Licence (Manufacturing — Medical Devices)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (EIA Registration with Environmental Management Plan) under the Environment Protection and Conservation Act No. 12 of 2002 (Cap 283); a full EIA Report is not mandated for clean medical-device assembly with ISO Class 7 cleanroom operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must meet Vanuatu National Effluent Standards: pH 6.5-8.5, BOD5 not exceeding 50 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L; sterilant gases (ethylene oxide / nitrogen dioxide) controlled to a WHO 8-hour time-weighted average occupational exposure limit of 1 ppm; VOC emissions minimised through local exhaust ventilation; hazardous electronic and sharp waste segregated and exported under Basel Convention transboundary controls.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Compliance Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service (Ministry of Internal Affairs) confirming egress, suppression, and alarm systems; structural load certificate under the Vanuatu Building Code 2020 verifying cleanroom floor load and seismic tie-downs; occupational clearance from WorkSafe Vanuatu under the Health and Safety at Work Act 2001 covering machine guarding, electrical safety, and personal protective equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), established under the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority Act No. 13 of 2014; official portal https://www.vrca.gov.vu, with customs declarations processed electronically through ASYCUDA World. Company incorporation and licensing are administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) with VFSC under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] to obtain the VFSC registration number and Certificate of Incorporation. Step 2: Obtain no income-tax TIN because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax and none is issued. Step 3: Apply to VRCA for a VAT Registration Number only if the IC makes domestic taxable supplies above VUV 5,000,000 per annum; ICs conducting exclusively international business are automatically exempt under s.55 of the IC Act and typically require no VAT number. Step 4: For physical export or import of endoscope hardware, open a Customs Client Account with VRCA Customs Division through ASYCUDA World to obtain a customs client code and file electronic entries.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone; the Vanuatu International Company is a non-resident offshore vehicle automatically exempt, without election, from corporate income tax, personal income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, VAT, and customs duties on all international business activities under s.55 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222], provided it does not trade with Vanuatu residents or hold land in Vanuatu; liability is limited and 100% non-resident ownership is permitted.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid-mismatch, or CFC election regimes exist because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. The s.55 IC Act exemption is automatic and self-executing; administratively, the IC may request a Certificate of Exemption from VFSC for bank and third-party reliance, and may technically apply for voluntary VAT registration under s.6 of the VAT Act to recover input VAT on domestic procurement, though this would create filing obligations and is generally inadvisable for a pure offshore exporter.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the VAT Act No. 12 of 1998, as amended, consolidated as CAP 201, administered by VRCA, supplemented by customs and excise duties under the Customs Act [CAP 91]; VAT applies to imports and to taxable supplies made in Vanuatu by registered persons.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 41,700) of annual taxable turnover in any 12-month period; registration is compulsory above the threshold and voluntary below it, and zero-rated export sales of an offshore IC fall outside the domestic VAT net.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government API stamping, or continuous transaction-controls mandate exists in Vanuatu. Registered persons must issue VAT tax invoices meeting the content requirements of Schedule 3 of the VAT Act and file periodic VAT returns through VRCA's online services portal; customs entries are cleared electronically through ASYCUDA World without supplementary digital stamping.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available under Schedule 1 of the VAT Act for: (1) goods physically exported from Vanuatu within 30 days of supply or such further period as the Commissioner approves; (2) international services supplied to recipients outside Vanuatu, including offshore servicing, warranty, training, and software updates for surgical laparoscopy towers; and (3) supplies for international ships or aircraft. The supplier must retain documentary proof of physical export and foreign receipt; any supply to a Vanuatu resident would be standard-rated at 12.5% and would also breach the IC Act's domestic-trading prohibition.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World entry outwards)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT MT103 evidencing foreign-currency settlement
Commercial Invoice and zero-rated VAT Tax Invoice
Certificate of Origin (issued by the Vanuatu Chamber of Commerce and Industry)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control law, so the 180-day figure is a commercial counterparty and clawback-risk benchmark rather than a statutory repatriation deadline. VRCA may raise default assessments and claw back improperly zero-rated supplies, with late payments subject to a 25% penalty plus 15% per annum statutory interest; fraudulent zero-rating claims are prosecutable under ss.41–42 of the VAT Act with fines up to VUV 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 7 years, and mirror-image penalties apply for false customs export declarations under the Customs Act [CAP 91]. An IC abusing the s.55 exemption through concealed domestic trading additionally risks VFSC strike-off and assessment of all standard-rated supplies with penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125]; jointly administers the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 77] with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) and supervises licensed banks under the Banking Act [Cap. 67].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalised floating exchange rate regime for the Vatu (VUV). The Exchange Control Act [Cap. 77] formally reserves approval powers over certain foreign exchange transactions; however, the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] expressly exempts International Companies (ICs) from exchange control restrictions, so the VU_IC entity may freely receive foreign currency, convert balances, and remit profits without prior RBV authorisation. Current-account convertibility is effectively unrestricted: payments for imported endoscope sub-components, royalties, commissions, logistics, and professional fees are processed freely through licensed commercial banks. Capital-account convertibility is equally unrestricted for ICs: shareholder equity injections, shareholder loans, intra-group repayments, and liquidation distributions carry no RBV permit requirement and crystallise no domestic withholding tax. The substantive convertibility constraint is offshore: VUV is a highly illiquid minor currency with no active deliverable market in Singapore, London, or New York; therefore practical convertibility is achieved by maintaining USD/EUR/AUD multicurrency accounts at ANZ Vanuatu or BRED Vanuatu and converting only the VUV tranche actually needed for local overheads (registered agent fees, legalisation, banking charges). Profit remittance is completely tax-neutral because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no dividend withholding tax, no interest withholding tax, and no capital gains tax on International Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation exists for the VU_IC. Under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 77] as applied in practice, an IC exporting Ultra-HD 4K laparoscopy tower systems is not required to convert export proceeds into VUV, and no fixed surrender timeline (e.g., 30/90 days) applies. Export collections may be retained indefinitely in USD, EUR, AUD, or any other permitted currency in an onshore or offshore account of the IC, may be netted against payable procurement commitments, and may fund dividend repatriation without RBV approval. The only operational compliance duty is bank-level reporting: licensed banks must file large-transaction and suspicious-transaction reports with the VFIU under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2006, and all international wires flowing through ANZ/BRED are captured in SWIFT message records retained for VFIU inspection. The IC must preserve underlying export contracts, commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and inspection certificates to evidence the commercial genuineness of each USD receipt in the event a correspondent bank raises a trade-based money laundering query.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD/AUD/VUV Multicurrency International Company Operational Account with SWIFT e-banking, LC issuance, and treasury dealing line
EUR/USD/VUV Multicurrency Treasury Account linked to BRED Paris clearing and eurozone correspondent network
AUD/VUV Corporate Settlement Account for Pacific-region distributor collections and liquidity buffers
VUV Domestic-Only Settlement Account reserved for resident-entity services; limited utility for non-resident IC trade flows

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low (Conditional). Vanuatu law has no statutory category for standalone electronic money institutions; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) licenses commercial banks, insurers, and securities dealers, and does not issue EMI or payment-institution licences. Every transaction possessing a Vanuatu nexus must be held at an RBV-licensed bank. Offshore regulated EMIs (e.g., UK FCA-authorised e-money institutions or US state-chartered fintech banks) may open multicurrency accounts for the IC as a non-resident legal person, and such accounts are valid for low-value disbursement and small receivables collection; however: (i) the initial capital injection and all high-value trade disbursements must remain booked at an RBV-licensed bank to preserve the commercial substance narrative of the VFSC-registered IC; (ii) processing material export proceeds through an external EMI without a Vanuatu-regulated intermediary raises correspondent de-risking risk because FATF and EU monitoring frameworks associate such structures with shell-company opacity; (iii) the IC Act non-resident perimeter is preserved by using EMIs exclusively for non-Vanuatu trade flows, never for Vanuatu-resident counterparties. Recommended architecture: ANZ or BRED as the primary treasury spine; a single regulated EMI confined to sub-USD 10,000 supplier convenience payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening of an IC bank account is legally permitted: no Vanuatu statute requires all directors to appear physically at a bank branch. In practice, ANZ Vanuatu and BRED Vanuatu require at least one physical appearance of the Chairman of the Board or a designated Managing Director at the Port Vila branch for initial onboarding; all other directors and authorised signatories may be processed through live-video KYC interviews, provided their passports are notarised and apostilled and the VFSC-registered agent issues an introducer letter. A minimum of two board-approved signatories is required, at least one of whom must be a natural person. If the account will clear USD through ANZ Australia/New York or EUR through BRED Paris, the correspondent bank may impose an additional face-to-face or senior compliance video call with the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO). The signed bank mandate and director details must exactly match the Register of Directors and Register of Shareholders maintained by the licensed agent in Port Vila.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity: nominee, trust, or layered holding structures above 25% of the IC, or a director resident in a high-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Certified Register of Directors and Register of Shareholders filed with the VFSC-registered agent; (ii) trust deed or nominee disclosure deed demonstrating economic ownership by the stated UBO; (iii) apostilled and notarised passports of all natural-person UBOs; (iv) signed UBO statutory declaration under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2006; (v) no-objection letter from the VFSC-registered agent confirming the independence of the corporate administration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth inadequacy: first capital injection above USD 250,000 without credible evidence of prior fund accumulation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Audited consolidated financial statements of the parent manufacturing group; (ii) 24-month historical bank statements of the remitting shareholder account; (iii) tax clearance certificate or corporate tax returns from the UBO jurisdiction of residence; (iv) executed purchase orders and distributor agreements for laparoscopy tower exports evidencing the commercial rationale; (v) accountant bridge letter explaining the accumulation of corporate reserves.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or sanctions screening hit: UBO or authorised signatory name matches a positive regulatory, media, or sanctions listing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Full World-Check or Refinitiv negative-news report with surrounding factual text and disposition evidence; (ii) affidavit distinguishing the name-match matter and confirming current clean status; (iii) national criminal record certificate issued by the UBO jurisdiction of citizenship; (iv) Vanuatu counsel legal opinion confirming no OFAC, EU, UK, or UN sanctions designation; (v) written undertaking to operate the account under enhanced transaction monitoring for 12 months.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell-characterisation risk: VFSC-registered IC with no local substance or employees classified as an offshore brass-plate treasury vehicle.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Full-chain trade documentation: OEM supply agreements, purchase orders, pro-forma invoices, Incoterms 2020 terms, shipping manifests, and customs entries; (ii) licensed-manufacturer compliance evidence: ISO 13485 certificate, CE marking declaration, and FDA establishment registration where applicable; (iii) board meeting minutes evidencing governance decisions executed by the registered office; (iv) product liability and product recall insurance certificates naming the IC as insured; (v) evidence that the IC bears real commercial risk and functions as the export-selling and treasury vehicle of the group.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual return (Form IC-AR) under s.117 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies and International Companies Registry, Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation (anniversary-date rule, not calendar-year rule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of VUV 5,000 (approx USD 42) per month or part thereof as prescribed; unpaid arrears continuing beyond six months after the due date expose the International Company to administrative dissolution by the Registrar; restoration requires settlement of all arrears plus a reinstatement fee of VUV 10,000 (approx USD 85).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership confirmation and register update under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Beneficial Ownership Registry (submitted through the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual return, i.e. within 30 days of each incorporation anniversary; additionally, within 14 days after any qualifying share transfer or beneficial ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance constitutes a criminal offence for each failure, attracting fines of up to VUV 2,000,000 (approx USD 16,500) and/or imprisonment; persistent default also constitutes grounds for administrative strike-off listing by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business licence renewal under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 223] (applicable only if the International Company maintains a physical place of business or conducts taxable local activity in Vanuatu)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Business Licence Unit, Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year rule: every business licence expires on 31 December; renewal for the following year must be applied for and paid before 1 January, or on the compliance date specified in the VFSC renewal notice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlicensed trading penalty of up to VUV 200,000 (approx USD 1,650) plus daily default fines; late renewal carries a 10% surcharge on the licence fee. A pure offshore International Company transacting exclusively outside Vanuatu is normally exempt from this licence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company; the Act does not require filing or public disclosure of financial statements. A certified audit becomes necessary only when (i) the memorandum, articles, or a shareholder/board resolution mandates it, (ii) a lender, insurer, or trading counterparty contractually requires audited accounts, or (iii) VFSC requests verification in connection with licensing or enforcement. There are no revenue- or asset-based audit thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No domestic GAAP is codified for offshore International Companies; IFRS as issued by the IASB is the recognised market framework for any voluntarily prepared or lender-required financial statements, with IFRS for SMEs acceptable for smaller trading entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the beneficial ownership transparency regime introduced by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021, the company must identify every beneficial owner (natural persons holding or controlling, directly or indirectly, 25% or more of shares or voting rights, or exercising control by other means) and maintain a complete Register of Beneficial Owners held by the licensed registered agent. The registered agent files beneficial ownership information with VFSC; any transfer of shares must be recorded and reported within 14 days; the annual confirmation consolidates all transfers and attests that the register is accurate and current as of the annual return filing date. Failure to update after a share transfer invalidates the annual confirmation and triggers the statutory penalty regime.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges, Mortgages and Encumbrances

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - 2,800 per annum for a licensed registered agent covering registered office, corporate secretarial duties, custody of statutory registers, and UBO administration
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - 15,000 per engagement for a voluntary or lender-mandated audit of a Vanuatu International Company holding the surgical laparoscopy towers manufacturing business, dependent on transaction volume, inventory, and consolidation scope

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (statutorily exempt as a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act, Cap 222; resident domestic companies are subject to 15%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full permanent tax exemption for International Companies: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax on dividends, interest or royalties; effectively 0% effective tax rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No annual corporate income tax return is required for an IC. Instead, file the annual return and compliance declaration under Section 78 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through the licensed Registered Agent; the VFSC e-Company Office portal (https://www.vfsc.vu/) is used for fee payment and record updates.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation, unless a longer period is applied by the Registered Agent. No CIT due date because the company is tax-exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full company name and certificate of incorporation number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as registered; the company is not required to obtain a Vanuatu tax registration number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be a licensed Vanuatu agent; non-resident directors or shareholders need not provide local addresses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Particulars of all directors and shareholders, including name, address, nationality, and shareholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident persons may hold the entire share capital; provide certified passport copies and proof of residential address for each beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance that the IC has not conducted prohibited domestic business or engaged in transactions with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm in the declaration that all activities are carried out outside Vanuatu, except for simple administrative matters; a false declaration is a criminal offence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return and payment of the annual license fee triggers a fixed late penalty of VT 10,000, plus a further VT 2,500 per month of delay. Continued default may lead to administrative striking-off under Section 100 of the IC Act, with the company's assets becoming vested in the Registrar.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company; non-resident shareholders receive dividends free of any Vanuatu tax).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No double taxation agreement with Vanuatu currently in force; only limited Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) exist. Therefore, treaty relief is not available. For foreign jurisdictions requiring a tax residency certificate (TRC) to credit the dividend, the shareholder must obtain a TRC from its home tax authority; there is no Vanuatu WHT to reclaim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT rate for interest and royalties paid by an IC is 0%. No separate treaty rate is applicable as no DTA exists; therefore the statutory 0% rate governs.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold under Vanuatu law for International Companies. Local threshold is N/A; must comply with foreign-parent-country OECD-aligned transfer pricing rules if the parent jurisdiction imposes such requirements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu applies economic substance requirements under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, but only for International Companies carrying on relevant activities (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property, distribution and service center). The manufacture of surgical laparoscopy towers is not a relevant activity; nevertheless the IC must maintain adequate substance for its actual foreign operations if it holds taxable income relevant to another jurisdiction, and must file the annual ESR declaration when required.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false declaration of compliance or intentionally withholding the fact that the IC has conducted prohibited domestic activities in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of the International Company status, withdrawal of tax exemption, a fine up to VT 500,000, and forced deregistration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the unpaid taxes and subject to criminal conviction, including travel bans, asset freezes, and imprisonment of up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating with no physical office, no employees, no substantive economic activity in Vanuatu while deriving overseas IP royalties, dividends, or interest, and then failing the substance assessment under the ESR Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties of up to VT 250,000, stripping of the IC tax exemption, exchange of beneficial ownership information to foreign tax authorities, and compulsory winding up.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face director disqualification, fines of up to VT 1,000,000, and imprisonment up to 5 years for knowingly maintaining a shell structure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a proper beneficial ownership register, failing to file suspicious transaction reports, or accepting wire funds linked to kickbacks in medical device procurement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act [Cap 279], fines up to VT 10,000,000, suspension of the registered agent, and revocation of the IC's certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors' personal assets may be seized; a court may issue travel bans and impose imprisonment up to 10 years for wilful money laundering offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sells or leases surgical laparoscopy equipment to Vanuatu hospitals or enters into any trade with a Vanuatu resident, breaching the IC Act's prohibition on domestic business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC incurs a financial penalty of VT 1,000,000 and may be ordered to be wound up by the Supreme Court under Section 36 of the IC Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly permitted the domestic trading are jointly and severally liable for all contractual debts incurred, and may be imprisoned for up to 3 years.
